dimension_grades.evidence: No wrong theories or false leads are described; the investigation is presented as a clean, linear four-step methodology with no missteps.
The post uses collective 'we' throughout and never attributes the bug or any misstep to the author personally; the framing is entirely blameless.
No time durations are mentioned for any phase of the investigation; the reader has no sense of how long anything took or how much effort was wasted.
The tone is neutral and professional throughout with no self-deprecation, wryness, or acknowledgment of personal embarrassment.
The root cause is revealed in the 'Root Cause' section immediately after 'The Problem,' before any investigation details are shared; no confusion is shown.
The investigation methodology is listed as a retrospective summary after the fix is already shown, so clues are not revealed incrementally.
The root cause is stated in the third section with no preceding tension: 'The issue turned out to be an event listener leak.'
No emotional states (frustration, surprise, relief) are expressed anywhere in the post; the tone remains detached and procedural throughout.
Takeaways are generic principles like 'Always monitor your memory usage in production' and 'Heap snapshots are your best friend' rather than specific behavior changes the author now follows.
The first takeaway is literally 'Always monitor your memory usage in production. You can't fix what you can't see' — textbook generic advice presented without any self-awareness.

Takeaways are stated as general principles without connecting back to specific moments in the narrative; e.g., 'Code reviews should pay special attention to resource cleanup' references no specific story event.
The tone is instructional and lecturing: 'Learn to use Chrome DevTools' memory profiling tools before you need them in an emergency' treats the reader as a student.
There are exactly two code snippets (problematic and fixed), which is a focused, minimal count.
The critical line in the first snippet has an inline comment: '// Bug: handler is never removed when this path executes'.
Both the problematic code and the fixed code are shown sequentially under 'Root Cause' and 'The Fix' sections.
Before the first snippet: 'Each incoming request registered a listener...but under a specific error-handling path, the listener was never removed' tells the reader what to look for.
No time of day, environmental detail, or sensory anchor is provided; the closest is 'over a period of several weeks,' which is vague and not scene-setting.
Real tool names are used: Prometheus, Chrome DevTools, Node.js 18, Express.
All moments are summarized retrospectively (e.g., 'We set up Prometheus metrics,' 'We used Chrome DevTools'); no moment is dramatized as a scene with action.
